body:
This is expected, input is processed in the following order, each subsequent method is called only if previous one did not mark input as handled:

```
_input
_gui_input				← text input (if Ctrl/Alt/Meta are not pressed)
_shortcut_input			← debuger shortcuts
_unhandled_key_input	← the rest of text input (with modifier keys pressed)
_unhandled_input
```
I tested your code and it worked. I made this PR and added you as co-author https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/119763
